experiment: YOLO11n PPE: explicit missing vest, local fine-tuning
selection: Selected fine-tuned best checkpoint on RF100 validation at confidence .4, NMS IoU .45, matching IoU .5 before test; original Construction-PPE test used as exploratory regression diagnostic.

config.sample_selection: sorted paths, first N; no shuffle

dataset.hash_scope: names, split and ordered evaluated image/label content hashes; missing labels marked explicitly

limitations: Fixed-threshold box precision/recall, not AP or mAP; no confidence sweep.
Only classes declared in YAML are scored; declaration does not prove exhaustive annotation.
Missing label files are treated as background; review the explicit list before interpreting false positives.
Per-person PPE states and equipment-person associations are not evaluated from isolated box labels.
Overlap with model training data is unknown; this report does not establish an independent held-out test.
Latency includes the first pipeline call, excludes image I/O and depends on the recorded hardware.

limitations: No independent field validation or real webcam/RTSP test.
No actual Telegram or email message sent; configured interface and mocked transport tested.
Negative helmet recall remains only 25% on both test datasets; errors and positive-vest regression on Construction-PPE retained.
RF100 labels include semantic noise and out-of-domain images. Exact hash audit cannot establish camera/person independence or exclude pretrained overlap.
Mean AP covers five annotated classes of ten model outputs. Box metrics do not evaluate PPE-person association or final alert accuracy.
Earlier best.pt INT8 export is a different model lacking no_vest; new absence.pt has not been quantized.
